title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Caribbean Crush 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Caribbean Crush is an exotic fusion of tropical fruits lifted with a cool, refreshing finish. Vibrant, juicy flavours burst through on the inhale, delivering a colourful medley of sun-ripened fruit flavours, while an icy exhale leaves a crisp and refreshing sensation making this an exceptional all-day vape for fans of bright fruit flavours. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers fast relief from cravings with a consistently smooth throat hit. The balanced 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures vibrant flavour clarity while keeping vapour production discreet, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
